title: Text: DET Ron Colangelo ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Tell me when the TV de██ expires and I will further your PR mission on Freep.com!
Told you to check Crain's story.
I'm not even going to use it, it's the principle of it
But there are more pressing needs
Leg██ly I am not in a position to do so
I need to c██l you when I get out of the metro
For this Cabrera story that Tony published
I am at a kids birthday party. Are your editors asking you to write something?
I mean, I'm kind of with you
Getting my bosses on board with that might be difficult, though
You are a beat reporter. They cannot put you in that situation. Tony is getting destroyed on soci██ media after he once publicly asked to "respect his privacy"
